text:
Nina Park: Hey design folks — quick review of the compact routing editor mock. Main asks: make reordering accessible, tighten preview real estate, and fix validation affordances. Screenshot + proto link: https://figma.com/file/abc

Ethan Moore: love the density. first nit: the drag handle blends with row actions. can we move it to the left edge and add a visible focus ring when keyboard-grabbed? :eyes:

Priya Shah: Agree on focus ring. Also, when a rule is pinned it should have a subtle divider and a label 'Pinned' so it doesn't look identical to a normal top rule. users confused in testing.

Liam O'Connor: validation placement: inline below rule is good but avoid pushing the preview pane. Suggest collapse/expand with max-height and micro animation. Also include a small error icon on the rule card so users can scan quickly.

Zoe Kim: copy for the inline error — current: "bad matcher". Suggest: "Syntax error in matcher. See examples." Keep it under 60 chars. Also add `aria-describedby` linking to the tooltip for screen readers.

Priya Shah: +1 aria-describedby. For the tooltip content, propose this: "Matchers support equals, contains, starts_with, regex. Surround regex with /.../. See docs." short and scannable.

Nina Park: Accessibility aside, preview sim: when users drag rules the simulated preview should update live but throttle updates to avoid churn (200ms debounce). Also show a small "live" badge while simulation is recalculating.

Ethan Moore: can we add a compactness toggle? dense / comfy. Some customers have huge rule lists and prefer no avatars/labels. Toggle persists per account.

Liam O'Connor: keyboard reorder sketch: Space to pick up, Arrow Up/Down to move, Space to drop. aria-live example: ```aria-live=\"polite\" -> \"Picked up rule 'US traffic - mobile'\" then \"Moved to position 3\"``` we should include polite announcements only.

UxBot: Accessibility scan: color contrast check failed for the preview legend in light theme. Recommend `--preview-amber: #B45309` and `--preview-accent: #065F46`. Also confirm focus halos are at least 3px.

Zoe Kim: microcopy for pin tooltip: "Pin keeps this rule at the top of the list and prevents auto-sorts from moving it." short.

Priya Shah: UX question: should pinned rules be excluded from simulation by default? Might be surprising. My vote: include them but show a pinned badge in the sim legend so users see effect.

Nina Park: decision list: 1) move handle left + larger hit area + focus ring, 2) inline error under card with collapse animation + icon, 3) add aria-describedby on errors and aria-live messages for reorder, 4) debounce live sim updates to 200ms + show live badge, 5) add density toggle persisted per account, 6) keep pinned rules in sim but add legend indicator. I'll update the design file and open tickets.

Ethan Moore: I'll prototype the left-handle affordance and the density toggle today.

Liam O'Connor: I'll write the aria strings and paste them into the component doc.

Zoe Kim: I'll push the microcopy changes and a short a11y checklist.

Nina Park: thanks all. tagging product-ux and routing-editor epic. timeline: aim for next sprint grooming. :rocket:
